tx: Calquat kegs are highly recommended, especially if the ale has matured. This creates dragon bitter (keg). Simply by collecting the ale in a keg, the value of the batch will increase by several thousand coins. This ale is considerably more useful in a keg, as it stacks 4 doses into one backpack slot.

Dragon bitter can be a fast, but tedious way to earn money. It takes less than 5 minutes to run from the bank in Yanille, to the pub, buy 28 pints of dragon bitter at 2 coins each and return to the bank. They must be bought as singles by talking to the bartender as there is no 'Trade' option. Based on the Grand Exchange price of and assuming the player is able to get 364 dragon bitter per hour, this method can enable a player to make per hour. However, it can be difficult to sell the dragon bitters due to a lack of demand.
